basis: Persistent hyperkeratosis defines EKV; listed systemic HPO findings are not established as common across this skin-disease umbrella.
Congenital structural disorders of skeletal muscle; respiratory muscle weakness does not establish direct lung damage.
Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor; rhabdomyoblastic differentiation does not establish skeletal muscle origin or involvement.
Craniosynostosis, radioulnar fusion and CNS malformations define it; renal agenesis/hypoplasia 80-99%, PDA 30-79%; laryngomalacia 30-79% omitted by cap.
Acute myeloid malignancy of blood and marrow defined by t(9;11); no established common additional organ damage.
LDB3-related skeletal myofibrillar myopathy; cardiomyopathy and peripheral neuropathy are minority findings, reported at 1-4%.
Inherited erythrocyte pyrimidine-metabolism defect causing hemolysis; jaundice does not establish hepatic injury; neurologic findings are rare.
Allergic, immune-mediated disease located in the digestive tract.
Ichthyosis, congenital mouth/lip abnormalities and digital abnormalities constitute the syndrome's defining triad.
Acquired partial lipodystrophy with complement-mediated subcutaneous fat loss; glomerulonephritis occurs in 26% and is separately diagnosed.
Squamous carcinoma arising in the esophagus; cough and voice changes do not establish direct respiratory organ damage.
Familial thoracic aortic disease; iris morphology and cutis marmorata do not establish functional damage; neurologic complications occur in a minority.
Poorly specified chromosome 3 duplication; neurodevelopmental impairment is typical, but duplication extent and additional organ frequencies are unknown.
Defined by cleft palate and tooth agenesis, stapes fixation with deafness, and carpal/tarsal skeletal fusions.
Chronic bacterial infection directly destroys renal parenchyma.
Idiopathic fibrosis and elastosis of pleura and lung parenchyma; infection or autoimmunity is not intrinsic to this diagnosis.
Hereditary disease group defined by abnormalities of vision and its neurologic pathways; no additional organ involvement can be established.
Malignancy arising in the vulva, a reproductive organ; smooth muscle histology does not imply locomotor muscle disease.
Cleft palate and microcephaly define it; skeletal delay 80-99%, muscle atrophy and ptosis 30-79%; nail defects omitted by cap; renal frequency unknown.
Malignant neoplasm involving the epicardium of the heart.
Hereditary motor neuron disease; sustained denervation causes distal muscle atrophy and weakness in 3/3 annotated patients, with limb deformities.
Autoimmune subepidermal blistering skin disease; mucosal disease is not established in at least 30%.
Congenital hindbrain displacement with associated neural tube and CNS abnormalities; dysphagia and apnea do not establish separate organ damage.
Defined by gonadal dysgenesis, cleft palate and congenital heart defects; kidney, brain and skeletal malformations are occasional, 5-29%.
Childhood malignant neoplasm arising in the kidney; no common additional organ involvement established across the group.
